business.name: ShopEase
business.description: ShopEase is a leading online retail store offering fashion, electronics, home accessories, and lifestyle products.
business.support_hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST

faqs.question: How can I track my order or package?
faqs.answer: You can track your order using the tracking link sent to your email after dispatch. You can also view live status in your ShopEase Account under 'My Orders'.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping arrives in 1 to 2 business days depending on your location.

faqs.question: How much does shipping cost?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping is FREE for orders over $50. Orders under $50 incur a flat standard shipping fee of $5.00.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: ShopEase offers a 30-day hassle-free return policy. Unused items in original packaging with tags attached can be returned for a full refund.

faqs.question: How long does a refund take to process?
faqs.answer: Once our warehouse receives and inspects your returned package, refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

faqs.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
faqs.answer: Yes! Exchanges are free within 30 days of delivery. You can start an exchange request through your account or by contacting support.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled or updated within 1 hour of placement. After 1 hour, processing begins and orders cannot be cancelled prior to delivery.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: ShopEase accepts Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Cash on Delivery (COD) in eligible regions.

faqs.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for eligible domestic shipping addresses. Availability is confirmed at checkout.

faqs.question: What should I do if I receive a damaged or incorrect item?
faqs.answer: We sincerely apologize! Please take clear photos of the damaged/wrong item and contact support within 48 hours for an immediate free replacement.

faqs.question: How can I check if an item is in stock?
faqs.answer: Product availability is shown live on each product detail page. If an item is sold out, click 'Notify Me' to receive an email alert upon restocking.

faqs.question: Where can I find size charts and product specifications?
faqs.answer: Detailed sizing charts, dimensions, material composition, and care instructions are located in the 'Specifications' tab on each product page.

faqs.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, ShopEase ships to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping fees and estimated delivery times are calculated at checkout.

faqs.question: How can I contact ShopEase customer support?
faqs.answer: Reach out to our support team via email at support@shopease-demo.com or call +1 (800) 555-EASE during business hours (Mon-Sat, 9AM-6PM EST).

faqs.question: Do I need an account to place an order?
faqs.answer: No, you can check out as a guest. However, creating a free ShopEase account allows you to track orders faster, save wishlists, and store addresses.
